title.narrative: UNICEF supported the development of key policies and strategies, including the National Education Policy, National Girls&39; Education Strategy, and National Safe Schools Framework. UNICEF’s technical support helped Malawi secure nearly S$100 million in grants for education. Additionally, 1,342 workers were trained on birth registration and referral processes, with impact on 823,000 children under the age of 16 years. ;;
